legacy_snapshot: Microsoft USBuildingFootprints legacy v2, seven frozen SHA-256 files
boundary_rule: reuse each frozen city land mask and representative-point membership, without clipping polygons
geometry_validity_rule: require valid source WGS84 geometry and valid positive-area metric-CRS geometry; preserve every rejected original in the audit universe
new_priority: retain valid, positive-area Polygon/MultiPolygon geometries; exact normalized-geometry duplicates retain the smallest stable source ID
invalid_new_policy: quarantine original invalid geometry, use its envelope as a conservative no-fill guard
legacy_candidate_rule: valid positive-area geometry, strict polygon-to-new-geometry distance greater than the clearance; no clipping, union, splitting or centroid-only deduplication
threshold_basis: conservative engineering guard, not a validated positional-error bound; 10 m also separates the primary fill from the existing near-match search distance
legacy_legacy_exact_duplicates: normalized geometry, retain smallest stable source ID
legacy_legacy_overlap_policy: quarantine every candidate in a positive-area overlap pair, never union or trim roofs
sensitivity_overlap_policy: detect legacy overlap conflicts at the least restrictive 2 m clearance and apply that same conflict mask at every clearance
nsi_role: match after geometric admission; ordinary RES1/RES2/RES3 only; unique G1 only is the primary statistic; G2 stays separate and manual-review pending
new_G1_preservation: require that no existing unique new-footprint G1 match becomes ambiguous or changes its matched new ID after adding legacy geometries
customer_semantics: geometric input only; final customer identity uses identified_residential_site_v3
temporal_policy: new capture date stays unknown; legacy capture range/release retained; a legacy fill is not verified current construction
scope: same national geometry rules; no per-city threshold optimization; production reference remains upstream
